reliability:CMMIMaturityLevel was considered for ontology maturity scoring and rejected: CMMI v2.0 is organisational process maturity, a different subject that shares a word (L-75).
oe-method's few release-history individuals still reference configuration:SprintManifest and related individuals as their subject matter, the same pattern as oe-pack's own, just far less populated.
core:Version, core:Process, core:Role and core:Metric are the primitives reliability, quality, risk and testing each build on.
